saw_lines: Gravel and all-mountain shoes get bought for one ride type, then bought again when the terrain changes.
So the sale is won in the first line, where a rider decides whether these shoes suit their ride.
Your 30 live ads carry no proof number, so collect one real figure, like your review count or orders shipped, and open the next three ads with it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: None of your 30 live ads shows a proof number, so a rider comparing brands has nothing to trust. Collect one real figure, like your review count or orders shipped, and open the next three ads with it on the creative.
0 of 26 copy ads carry an offer, so a new buyer has no reason to act today. Give buyers one reason, a first order offer or a bundle of shoes, and put it in line one of three new ads.
6 ads have run 60+ days yet none of the 24 newer ads reuses a winner’s opening line. Build the next three ads as variations of the oldest winner, keeping its opening and swapping in the new product.

15 different openings run across 26 copy ads, and the biggest one opens 4. Each new story starts from zero, so nothing you learn carries over. Pick the two best stories and build the next batch from them, three ads each.
